Homebrew: an alternative to the real granted "Dragon Breath (Dragon Form)" action for the Crystal dragon type. That action already dynamically gets the correct damage type and amount, and heightens correctly at 8th level (confirmed by reading the shared Spell Effect: Dragon Form item's full rule set -- it uses DamageAlteration rule elements targeting the action's own inline damage roll, not something missing entirely) -- but its save is plain descriptive text with no clickable button. This spell is a genuine alternative with real structured area/damage/defense fields, so its save button rolls against this character's actual spell DC directly, same as any other spell.

You exhale deadly magical energy in a 30-foot cone, dealing 10d6 piercing damage to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. Once activated, Dragon Breath can't be used again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Dragon Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

Heightened (8th) The damage increases to 14d6.
